name: Alex Example
headline: Operations & Content Production Coordinator
summary: A detail-oriented operations and content production professional with fluent English and Spanish. Proven track record in running quality checks, managing digital assets, and coordinating fast-paced content pipelines for international clients. Experienced in vendor management, defect tracking (Jira), and cross-functional collaboration to ensure accurate, on-time delivery of media components and localised material.

bullets: Acted as the central production coordinator for a weekly streaming series, managing a continuous content pipeline and delivering ~25 time-sensitive video assets each week.
Directed external vendors, including a design agency and freelance videographers; reviewed creative output, handled rejections, and enforced strict delivery schedules.
Established a digital asset management structure in Google Drive, categorising raw footage and final media for rapid retrieval and same-day publishing.
Tracked workflows, approvals and deadlines in Trello, keeping communication clear across teams in several time zones.
Executed structured test plans on multilingual game builds, logging reproducible defects in Jira with clear steps, severity and evidence.
Verified text, audio and subtitle content against source scripts and style guides, cutting repeat defects between builds.
Worked with producers and developers to triage issues before milestone deadlines.
Wrote concise release notes summarising open issues for non-technical stakeholders.
Analysed client procurement data and produced weekly summaries for the account team.
Maintained a shared tracker of open tasks and supplier correspondence.
Compiled sources and prepared briefing notes for a faculty research project.
Coordinated interview schedules and transcribed recorded sessions.
Prepared shipping documents and customs paperwork for inbound orders.
Updated stock records and answered supplier queries by email.
